app.name: Mandi Advisor
app.tagline: Sell now or hold? Ask in your language.

login.title: Log in with your mobile number

ask.placeholder: Type your question, e.g. Should I sell my onion now?
ask.empty: Ask about onion, tomato or potato prices, or whether to sell now or hold.
examples: Should I sell my onion now or wait?
I have 20 quintals of tomato. Sell today?
I have potatoes in cold storage. Hold or sell?
ask.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ask.useLocation: Use my location for transport cost

voice.unsupported: Voice input is not available in this browser. Please type instead.
voice.failed: Could not hear clearly. Please speak again or type.

prices.title: Mandi prices
prices.demo: These are demo (synthetic) prices, not real market reports.

settings.title: Settings
settings.keepRecordings: Let the server keep my voice recordings to improve speech recognition
settings.keepRecordingsHelp: Off by default. When off, recordings are deleted right after they are turned into text.

offline.banner: You are offline. Showing saved prices; answers need internet.
offline.noAnswer: You are offline. Connect to the internet to ask a question.

alerts.title: Price alerts
alerts.none: No alerts yet. Get notified when the price crosses a level.
alerts.pushNote: On the website, alerts appear here. The mobile app also sends a notification.
